summary: The trivial lift is invariant under the action of ∏ GL_1(𝔽_w) on forms (adjointness and the theta descent); the label idempotent of X − 1 in dimension one averages the trivial character, so it fixes the trivial lift, which is therefore in the range.

steps.claim: Write Y for the L-value data p.lValueData H.1 ϑ.

For every s ∈ ∏ GL_1(𝔽_w) and every form Ξ on V: ⟨Ξ_p, s·Ξ⟩ = ⟨Ξ_p, Ξ⟩: both sides are class sums of the theta descent of Ξ (inner_trivialLift), and the descent of s·Ξ is the descent of Ξ translated by a lift of s (theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction, reduceFamily_liftResidue), which the class sum absorbs.
steps.lean:
have K s Ξ := (Y.inner_trivialLift 1 (Y.auxPair.formAction s Ξ)).trans (.trans (by
    simp [← AuxPair.theta_mul_eq_theta_formAction _ _ (reduceFamily_liftResidue s)]; rfl)
    (Y.inner_trivialLift ..).symm)

steps.claim: For every finite place w and g ∈ GL_1(𝔽_w): the class function of the label X − 1 (labelChar of X − x_1, x_1 naming the trivial character) evaluated at g is 1 (labelChar_X_sub_C, evalGL_detChar).
steps.lean:
have (w : FinPlace D.E)
    (g : GL Unit (ResField w)) := congr($(labelChar_X_sub_C (faithfulChar (ResField w)) 1).evalGL
    g).trans ((ite_eq_left (by simp)).trans ((evalGL_detChar ..).trans
      (MulChar.one_apply_coe g.det)))

steps.claim: Take Ξ_p itself: tupleProj Ξ_p = Ξ_p, tested against every Ξ: ⟨e·Ξ_p, Ξ⟩ = ⟨Ξ_p, e·Ξ⟩ (e symmetric) = Σ_g (coefficient of g in e)·⟨Ξ_p, g·Ξ⟩ = ⟨Ξ_p, Ξ⟩, because by steps 2 and 3 the coefficients of the label idempotent of X − 1 (a label, isApt_rank_one) are those of the average over the group and sum to 1.
steps.lean:
use Y.trivialLift, ext_inner_right ℂ (by simp_all [↓IsApt.isSymmetric_tupleProj _ _,
    asAlgebraHom_eq_sum, tupleIdem, inner_sum, inner_smul_right, labelIdem,
    prod_ne_zero_iff, ↓(isApt_rank_one _ H).isLabel])
